versions.content: service method VerifyStatusOverride [SWS_CM_10050] Upstream: RS_CM_00801 , RS_CM_00802 , RS_CM_00803 , RS_CM_00804 VerifyStatusOverride (IN uint16_t dataID, IN OverrideStatus overrideStatus, IN uint8_t numberOfMessagesToOverride) This service method provides the ability to force specific behavior of SecOc: accept or drop a message with or without performing the verification of authenticator or independent of the authenticator verification result, and to force a specific result for VerificationStatusResult allowing additional fault handling in the application. Scope service interface VerificationStatusConfigurationByDataId class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td dataID td IN td uint16_t td Data ID for which the override operation shall happen td overrideStatus td IN td OverrideStatus td The override status enum that defines whether verification is executed and whether the message is passed on, and for how long the override is active td numberOfMessagesToOverride td IN td uint8_t td Number of sequential VerifyStatus to override when using a specific counter for authentication verification. This is only considered when OverrideStatus is equal to k SecOcOverrideDropUntilLimit, kSecOcOverrideSkipUntilLimit or kSecOcOverride PassUntilLimit.
